Ctx.AddNpcForAll: Add {name} to Familiar Faces for all players

Notify.Name: Notifications
Notify.Hint: Tell players when someone new is added, gets a portrait, or a note is shared with them.

PlayersCanAdd.Name: Players can add NPCs
PlayersCanAdd.Hint: Let players add people to Familiar Faces themselves (Add NPC button and right-click on a selected name). Portraits stay GM-only.

ImageFolder.Name: Portrait upload folder
ImageFolder.Hint: Where uploaded portraits are saved. Empty: worlds/<world>/familiar-faces.

SelectionMenu.Name: Right-click selected names
SelectionMenu.Hint: Right-clicking a selected name in a journal offers to add it to Familiar Faces. Hold Shift for the normal menu.

ImageMenu.Name: Right-click journal images (GM)
ImageMenu.Hint: Right-clicking an image in a journal offers to use it as the portrait of an NPC. Hold Shift for the normal menu.

KnownNameplates.Name: Show the names of NPCs the party knows
KnownNameplates.Hint: When an NPC is in every player's Familiar Faces, all tokens of that NPC (in every scene, and new ones) show their name to everyone on hover. Needs a GM logged in; names are never hidden again by the module.

TokenMenu.Name: Right-click NPC tokens
TokenMenu.Hint: Players: right-clicking an NPC's token offers to add them to your own Familiar Faces (hold Shift to skip it). GM: a Familiar Faces button on NPC token HUDs adds them for all players.
